items.title: A Spirit of Service: Gary Banaszak Pens Patriotic Poem as He Sails into Retirement
items.description: Gary R. Banaszak, a dedicated Navy veteran and civilian Contract Specialist at NAS Patuxent River, is retiring after more than 41 years of combined active-duty and civilian service to the United States Navy. To mark his departure and honor the nation's upcoming 250th anniversary, Banaszak penned a patriotic poem titled "Seaman Spirit."

items.title: Pax Sailors Learn to Master Their Barracks Kitchens with ‘No Thyme to Cook’
items.description: The "No Thyme to Cook" program at NAS Patuxent River is a new, hands-on cooking initiative designed to help junior Sailors living in Unaccompanied Housing make full use of their in-room kitchens. Led by local cooking school owner Chef Gwyn Novak and Executive Chef V. Wiepreeht, the four-week course teaches essential cooking techniques, budget-friendly shopping, and proper food safety to promote healthy, independent living.
